thread:
Anika K: Morning — rolling BlueRiver into private tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go: net ACLs, image sync, certs, and air-gap media transfer. Who's owning last-mile validation?
Matt D: I can take network ACLs + firewall NAT, will run smoke at 08:00 UTC. @KevinL can you confirm BGP/route reflectors?
Kevin L: I'm out on PTO but left the routing notes in the playbook. Jamal, can you cover routing + NAT tests? Playbook section: `routing-checks` (see ops runbook).
Jamal R: Happy to cover. Quick Q — do we have the pre-seeded image hash for BlueRiver v2.2? I only see an old artifact in staging.
OpsBot: Artifact upload completed: s3://redwood-private/artifacts/blueriver/v2.2/sha256:f3a9b7c4d5e6f7890123456789abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef Size 3.1GB — digest available.
Priya S: Cert rotation is still pending — need the customer's intermediate CA signed chain. Leah, you were going to coordinate with their security team, status? :thinking:
Leah T: I pinged them at 05:30 PT, they're still signing. They said EOD but could slip. If not received, we fallback to managed short-lived certs (need CS approval).
Anika K: Decision: if intermediate not in by 20:00 PT today we'll use managed cert and note customer caveats. @MattD please add the fallback to the runbook and the cutover ticket.
Matt D: On it. Also surfaced air-gap blocker — their image signer doesn't accept our OIDC flow. Proposal: create a temporary static token in `secrets/airgap-tokens` scoped to image-pull, rotate after cutover. Anyone opposed? :shrug:
Priya S: Not ideal but acceptable for the cutover. Must be documented and rotated within 24h. Add audit log entry.
Jamal R: I'll run a dry-run of the egress prober with the static token on staging tonight and paste logs back here after ~22:15 UTC.
OpsBot: Deploy scheduled: private-cutover-blueriver at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Canary policy: 10% for 15m. Oncall: Anika K, Matt D. Incident channel: #incidents.
Anika K: Thanks. One more ask — can someone double-check NTP/chrony on customer hosts? We've tripped cert validation due to drift before.
Kevin L: Left an ntpcheck cron in the playbook before PTO. Jamal — please run ntpcheck in preflight.
Jamal R: NTP check passed on staging a few hours ago, will run prod preflight early.
Leah T: Preparing rollback snippet: revert to hosted-route and revoke static token, plus step to notify customer security. I'll drop it into the ticket.
Anika K: Final owners for tomorrow: network = Matt D + Jamal R; certs = Leah T; artifacts = OpsBot (s3) + Matt D; oncall = Anika K. If anything slips, ping this thread and escalate to #incidents. :thumbsup:
